disposition.claimed: The engine as it will stand in 0.4.0 keeps the capability; carried_by names the 0.4.0 requirement that carries it, and changed_form says so where the original text no longer holds as written. The accepted set is every entry whose disposition is this word.
disposition.retired: The capability leaves with what this version removes; surfaces says with what, removed_by names the working-route entry that removes it, and guard says what holds it until that entry runs.

surface.window: The desktop window: the shell, the webview interface, its IPC routes, the tray, the updater and notification plugins, and the gates that drive them.
surface.model: The local model and everything that served it: interpretation, the cadence coordinator and the digest.
surface.desktop: The desktop's distribution: bundles, the updater channel, package channels. Named by P-117; none of the 82 ids is about it.
surface.workspace: Workspace detection and the workspace incident key.
surface.training-export: The export of corpus content for training.
surface.corpus-encryption: Encryption of the corpus at rest and the custody of its key.

guard.runs: Every automated proof the superseded records name for the id runs in a CI job; by lists them.
guard.part: At least one automated proof the superseded records name runs in a CI job (by) and at least one runs in no gate (unrun).
guard.none: No proof of the id runs in any gate; unrun lists the automated proofs the superseded records name.
